label: Earthquakes in Oklahoma would start and keep getting bigger
description: He says he prophesied at his old church, before the channel existed, that earthquakes would begin in Oklahoma and that the Lord told him not to be afraid because they would get bigger and increase, naming 5.2 to 5.5 as large for Oklahoma, and tying the sequence forward to the New Madrid fault. Recounted on 21 January 2024; the original telling is not in this corpus.
